headword: {安全|あんぜん}{運転|うんてん}

definitions.explanation: Driving a vehicle carefully and in accordance with traffic rules to avoid accidents. A common term in traffic safety campaigns and driving education.

examples.japanese: {安全|あんぜん}{運転|うんてん}を{心|こころ}がけてください。
{雨|あめ}の{日|ひ}は{特|とく}に{安全|あんぜん}{運転|うんてん}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Safe driving is especially important on rainy days.

examples.japanese: {安全|あんぜん}{運転|うんてん}{講習|こうしゅう}を{受|う}けたおかげで、{運転|うんてん}に{自信|じしん}がついた。
examples.english: Thanks to taking a safe driving course, I gained confidence in driving.

notes:
USAGE:
A standard compound seen on road signs, in driving schools, and in public safety campaigns. Often used with {心|こころ}がける (to keep in mind) or {徹底|てってい}する (to ensure thoroughly).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {安全|あんぜん}{運転|うんてん}を{心|こころ}がける (to practice safe driving)
- {安全|あんぜん}{運転|うんてん}{講習|こうしゅう} (safe driving course)
- {安全|あんぜん}{運転|うんてん}{義務|ぎむ} (obligation to drive safely)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {運転|うんてん}: driving — general term
- {危険|きけん}{運転|うんてん}: dangerous driving — the opposite
